name: Saasyio
summary: Light, framed workflow-automation SaaS page in periwinkle and off-white, with hatched bands, halftone dot illustrations and a live product card as hero.

fonts.pairing: Inter 500 with very tight negative tracking for headings (about -6%), Inter body at 14px with tight tracking, pill badges

signature: page held inside a framed column with 1px side rails and thin diagonal-hatch bands separating each section
halftone dot-matrix illustrations (planet, shield, target) mixing black and periwinkle dots
hero product window on a periwinkle dot-field plate, with a prompt box that turns a sentence into a workflow
imagery: no photography; halftone dot pictograms, product UI cards, app logos in tiles, a dotted city skyline under the footer CTA
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, framed 1120 column with rails, 120px section padding with 80px inner sides, 40px hatched dividers, 3-col grids, 24px card radius and pill buttons
